description:
Desktop AI agent with plugins, an embedded browser, workspace files, and local model support.

Lexora is a personal AI agent that evolves through hands-on work on your desktop. Beyond coding, it helps you organize research, refine creative projects, and plan everyday activities. Tell it what you want to accomplish, and it keeps working toward that goal, making words the starting point for work, creativity, and everyday life.
This release focuses on split-pane performance in complex tasks, task cleanup, and making local models more useful.
Split-pane dragging time in complex states has dropped from 8 seconds to 1 second, making multi-pane workflows smoother. New task archiving and permanent cleanup let you put temporary tasks aside and remove their data when no longer needed, preventing leftovers from accumulating on disk. We’ve also refined support for less-capable local models to make tool calling easier, alongside better local image-to-image workflows, including reference-image handling and saving generated results.
The image viewer now supports zooming, rotation, copying, and referencing, while Chinese input users can access commands and Skills directly. This release also improves local inference diagnostics, cloud backup, MCP settings, and the macOS menu bar icon.
